content: सनाथ {%a.%} .²1 Having a master, lord or husband; त्वया नाथेन वैदेही सनाथा ह्यद्य वर्तते <ls>Rām.</ls> .²2 Possessed of a guardian or protector; सनाथा इदानीं धर्मचारिणः <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; सनाथः संवृत्तः <ls>V. 5</ls>. .²3 Occupied by, possessed by. .²4 Provided or furnished with, having, possessing, endowed with, full of; usually in <ab>comp.</ab>; लतासनाथ इव प्रतिभाति <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; शिलातलसनाथो लतामण्डपः <ls>V. 2</ls>; <ls>Me. 100</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 94</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 42</ls>; <ls>V. 4. 10</ls>. .²5 Crowded (as an assembly). .{@-था@} A woman whose husband is living.
